fromChainId.description: The chain of the token to sell

toChainId.description: The chain of the token to buy; fromChainId when omitted

sellToken.description: A listed symbol or a contract address

buyToken.description: A listed symbol or a contract address

amount.description: A decimal amount in token units

wallet.description: The wallet that sells the token and signs the returned calls

recipient.description: The address that receives the bought token; the wallet when omitted

maxSlippageBps.description: The maximum slippage in basis points, from 0 to 5000, and at least 1 for a cross-chain plan that swaps on both chains; 50 when omitted

chainId.description: The chain the transaction was sent on; required unless requestId is a gas order's, in g:<chainId>:<orderHash> form

txHash.description: The transaction hash, also while it is pending; required unless requestId is a gas order's, in g:<chainId>:<orderHash> form

requestId.description: The requestId of the plan, used to compare the transaction with it, or of a gas order, in g:<chainId>:<orderHash> form, which is enough alone

query.description: A symbol or a contract address

payChainId.description: The chain the USDC is paid on; required without offer, not accepted with it

chainId.description: The chain the native gas is for; required without offer, not accepted with it

recipient.description: The address that receives the gas; required without offer, not accepted with it

amount.description: A decimal amount in token units

wallet.description: The paying wallet; required with offer. Without offer, the answer holds an authorization to sign only when it is given, and it is the refund address when refundTo is not given

refundTo.description: The refund address on the paying chain; a cross-chain order needs refundTo or wallet, and a one-chain order with neither uses recipient; not accepted with offer

offer.description: The offer value from the answer to a call without offer; when given, the signed order is submitted and only offer, signature and wallet are accepted

signature.description: The wallet's hex signature of the offer's USDC authorization; required with offer, not accepted without it
